india-macro.title: India's economic activity growth hits four-year high of 9% in October: Jefferies
india-macro.summary: India's economic activity growth hit a four-year high of 9% year-on-year in October. The increase was largely attributed to strong industrial activity and a delayed festive season. However, rural demand indicators remained weak due to a subdued monsoon. While bank credit growth reached a nearly 12-year high, inflationary pressures intensified simultaneously. Overall, the report highlights a mixed outlook for future economic activity amidst varying consumer behaviors.
